note: Blackboard / agent-memory / persistent-state provider catalog. A 'blackboard' is the shared, append-only, provenance-tracked store a stateful swarm writes to (see architecture/stateful_swarm_provider_catalog.json + docs/research/stateful-swarms-irys.md). This catalog enumerates candidate backends for the BlackboardProviderPort. EVERY non-local provider is a CANDIDATE behind the port with a working local_equivalent and do_not_adopt_as_primary=true; the single active authority is the offline append-only SQLite stub (blackboard.local_sqlite@v1), which requires no Docker/network/keys and NEVER writes truth (every entry needs source_refs + receipts + tenant_scope; verification and serving happen in Baltor, not here). Read by scripts/check_stateful_swarm_provider_catalog.py.
governance_law: discovery != trust; candidate != active; a blackboard is ANALYTICAL agent state and is NEVER served truth — Baltor governs served truth (authority_rank/claim_status/verification_status/held_out_reason/freshness/temporal_validity/tenant_scope/promotion_eligibility/receipt_refs/source_handles); a benchmark result is EVIDENCE, NEVER promotion authority; every gated (non-active) provider keeps a working local_equivalent and is marked do_not_adopt_as_primary; the active authority is the local append-only SQLite store with source_refs + receipts + tenant_scope required and no truth writes; credentials are env:// references only — no raw keys.

entries.name: Local append-only SQLite blackboard
entries.benchmark_is_evidence_note: No benchmark gates this provider — it is the offline correctness invariant for the BlackboardProviderPort.
entries.proof_to_promote: Already active — offline, append-only, requires source_refs + receipt_refs + tenant_scope on every write, writes no served truth; this is the fallback the whole port depends on.

entries.name: Graphiti temporal knowledge graph (Zep)
entries.benchmark_is_evidence_note: Temporal-graph recall benchmarks (Zep paper) are EVIDENCE for the temporal model, not a promotion authority; cross-listed with architecture temporal-graph provider work.
entries.proof_to_promote: Implement the BlackboardProviderPort over Graphiti behind the local fallback, prove the same governed facts project read-only (never canonical truth), and keep blackboard.local_sqlite@v1 as the correctness invariant; requires Neo4j/FalkorDB/Neptune + LLM keys, so never the default path.

entries.name: Letta (formerly MemGPT) stateful-agent memory
entries.benchmark_is_evidence_note: Agent-memory benchmark results are EVIDENCE, not authority; Letta is a runtime, never Baltor's served truth.
entries.proof_to_promote: Wrap Letta's persisted agent memory behind the BlackboardProviderPort with the local fallback intact; its memory blocks become CANDIDATE entries (never served facts), governed by Baltor before any serving; needs a Letta server + LLM keys, so never the default path.

entries.name: LangGraph checkpoint / state persistence
entries.benchmark_is_evidence_note: Checkpoint/time-travel state is workflow plumbing, not truth; no benchmark promotes it.
entries.proof_to_promote: Adapt the LangGraph checkpointer behind the BlackboardProviderPort as a workflow-state candidate (snapshots are intermediates, not served facts), keeping the local SQLite store as the invariant; coupled to the LangGraph runtime + LLM keys, so never the default path.

entries.name: AutoGen + Mem0 agent memory layer
entries.benchmark_is_evidence_note: Mem0's recall-accuracy claims are EVIDENCE, not authority; self-improving memory must be governed (its derived/forgotten facts map to held_out/candidate, never served truth).
entries.proof_to_promote: Wrap the Mem0/AutoGen memory layer behind the BlackboardProviderPort with the local fallback; derived/auto-forgotten memories map to candidate/held_out (lossless-distillation law: omitted != deleted), never served as fact; needs Mem0/LLM keys, so never the default path.

entries.name: seekdb AI-native write-heavy state store (OceanBase)
entries.benchmark_is_evidence_note: seekdb write-throughput / hybrid-search benchmarks are EVIDENCE for the storage layer, not a promotion authority; the store holds CANDIDATE state, not served truth.
entries.proof_to_promote: Adapt seekdb (MySQL-compatible, hybrid vector+full-text, COW FORK/MERGE sandboxes) behind the BlackboardProviderPort for write-heavy swarm state, keeping blackboard.local_sqlite@v1 as the invariant; COW branches are intermediates, never served truth; embedded/server deploy + Docker, so never the default path.
